lines.face: Stand on your mat, facing the kibla. Make your intention in your heart.
lines.begin: Raise your hands to your ears, to begin the prayer.
lines.fold: Place your right hand over your left, on your chest.
lines.rise2: Stand up for the second raka.
lines.rise3: Stand up for the third raka, raising your hands.
lines.rise4: Stand up for the fourth raka.
lines.bow: Raise your hands, then bow. Hands on your knees, back flat.
lines.rising: Rise up, raising your hands to your ears.
lines.lower: Lower your hands to your sides, and praise your Lord.
lines.prostrate: Go down into prostration, hands before knees. Forehead and nose on the ground.
lines.sitUp: Sit up, and rest a moment.
lines.sit: Sit, and rest your hands on your thighs.
lines.right: Turn your face to the right, and say the salaam.
lines.sayRuku: Glorify your Lord, the Most Great, three times.
lines.saySujud: Glorify your Lord, the Most High, three times.
lines.sayJalsah: Ask your Lord for forgiveness and mercy.
lines.sayTashahhud: Recite the tashah-hud, pointing with your right index finger.
lines.saySalawat: Send blessings upon the Prophet, peace be upon him.
lines.sayRefuge: Seek refuge in Allah, before the salaam.
lines.complete: Well done. Your prayer is complete.
lines.afterPrayer: After the prayer, ask Allah's forgiveness, three times.
